verdict.rationale: Ramp ships a broad programmatic surface: an OpenAPI spec with 174 paths, OAuth scopes covering transactions, bills, cards, banking and more, plus a CLI and an MCP server that cover approvals, reimbursements, receipts, purchases and travel. However, no source claims full UI parity, and the docs name UI-only or gated steps: applicants must finish sign-up in the Ramp UI, bill approvals point to the UI or a separate API, and incorporation is private-preview. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, evidence that all UI workflows (e.g., settings and admin configuration) are exposed via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration of coverage.
